title: CYBRIK internal service-delegation token (decoded) v1
description: Structural shape of a DECODED short-lived internal service-delegation access token — the application-layer (E3) half of the W2-F two-layer trust seam (ADR-0006 E2/E3; ADR-0008). It is a RFC 9068 JWT access-token profile: header carries explicit typ 'at+jwt' and an asymmetric alg (RFC 8725 — no HS*/none); claims carry the RFC 7519 registered set (iss/sub/aud/exp/nbf/iat/jti), the RFC 8705 §3.1 'cnf' certificate-bound proof-of-possession, an RFC 6749 scope, and the CYBRIK namespaced authorization claims (tenant/org/actor/operation/marking). It is minted by the SOC downstream-mint authority and validated by Cyber AI. This decoded shape is what a relying party MUST check AFTER signature verification against pinned JWKS trust; a raw private key, symmetric secret, static bearer, or forwarded end-user token is NEVER a field here. $id uses the RFC 2606 .example documentation domain; it is an identifier, NOT an endpoint. Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). Accepted at Gate W2-F (Codex under Founder delegation, 2026-07-24).

header.description: JOSE protected header. alg is asymmetric-only (jwtAlg enum excludes every HS* and 'none'); typ is the RFC 9068 §2.1 explicit access-token type; kid pins the verification key in the issuer JWKS.

typ.description: RFC 9068 §2.1 explicit typing: a delegation token MUST be typed 'at+jwt' so a relying party can reject a token minted for a different purpose (RFC 8725 §3.11).

kid.description: Key id (RFC 7515 §4.1.4). Selects the pinned public key in the issuer JWKS; verification MUST fail closed if it resolves to no pinned key.

claims.description: The delegation claim set. additionalProperties:false: a claim the profile does not define cannot ride along, so a forwarded end-user token, static bearer, or injected authority claim has nowhere to live.

sub.description: Subject (RFC 7519 §4.1.2): the delegated principal/session this token acts for. Advisory identity; authoritative identity derives from the mTLS peer certificate + cnf, never from sub alone.

cybrik.actor.description: The authoritative acting party this delegation carries. tenant_id required because cross-tenant authorization is evaluated at the relying party against this claim.

cybrik.marking.description: The HIGHEST data marking this token authorizes the operation to touch. A downstream request whose body marking is above this on the classification/TLP lattice MUST be rejected (marking non-escalation; runtime).

cybrik.delegation_ref.description: OPTIONAL, DISJOINT reference to an accepted cybrik.delegation-chain.v1 tool-execution grant (ADR-0004 E3). This application-delegation token is NOT that digest-bound tool grant; it MAY name one for correlation but never substitutes for it.
